SELECT user_id, kakaoId, login_id, password_hash, name, email, role, status FROM users WHERE login_id = #{login_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users( academy_id, login_id, password_hash, name, email, phone, role, status, created_at, kakaoId ) VALUES (#{academy_id},#{login_id},#{password_hash}, #{name},#{email},#{phone}, #{role},#{status},NOW(), #{kakaoId})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, academy_id, login_id, name, email, role, status, kakaoId FROM users
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET status = #{status}, /* 상태가 탈퇴(WITHDRAWN)로 바뀌면 현재 시간을 기록하고, 다른 상태로 바뀌면 날짜를 지움 */ withdrawn_at = CASE /* case : 조건 */ WHEN #{status} = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END WHERE user_id = #{user_id}

UPDATE users SET status = #{status}, withdrawn_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END WHERE user_id IN /* IN : 조건 */
#{id} /* userId에서 id(회원번호)를 하나씩 꺼냄, 커낸 (예:1,2,3)을 {id}자리에 넣음 */
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM users WHERE status = 'WITHDRAWN' AND withdrawn_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
